Henry Wiltshire Estate Agents are delighted to bring to the rental market this luxurious, top-of-the-range 4-bedroom semi-detached home in Naas.

Welcome to this exceptional residence, where designer interiors, elegant finishes and thoughtful functionality combine to create a truly impressive home.

This beautifully presented property seamlessly blends luxury, privacy and modern living, with a sophisticated interior designed for both comfortable family living and entertaining.

From the moment you enter, the quality and attention to detail are immediately apparent. The property features a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, bespoke built-in shelving, warm timber finishes and carefully selected contemporary furnishings.

The impressive accommodation includes four spacious bedrooms, with the principal bedroom offering a striking feature wall, upholstered headboard and a beautifully calm, neutral colour palette. The remaining bedrooms are equally well presented, while the contemporary bathrooms complement the overall high-end finish.

A Truly Exceptional Garden
To the rear, the property boasts a spectacular private landscaped garden, providing a peaceful outdoor oasis and an extension of the home's living space.

The garden features extensive decking, mature planting, a beautiful ornamental pond, outdoor dining area and a covered pergola, creating an exceptional setting for relaxing and entertaining.

A charming glasshouse and mature greenery further enhance this unique outdoor space, while the established planting provides an excellent level of privacy.

 Elsmore is a truly exceptional rental property, offering sophisticated interiors, generous living accommodation and an outstanding private garden.
